high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot from a presentation during the Romanes Lectures at the University of Oxford. The slide is titled "Conclusion" and discusses the comparison between digital computation and biological computation. Slide Content: The slide is divided into two main bullet points under the title "Conclusion." The first bullet point discusses digital computation: It states that digital computation requires a lot of energy but makes it very easy for agents with the same model of the world to share what they have learned by sharing weights or gradients.
